How underline text works

The generator adds a combining mark after plain or supported styled Latin letters and digits. Single and double variants use line marks; the dotted variant places two dots below each eligible character. Spaces, punctuation, existing accents, emoji and other scripts stay unchanged. Line continuity depends on the destination’s font.

Where it helps

Use an underline for a short accent and preview it after pasting. Use native underlining for important document formatting when it is available.

Underline text without formatting tools

These styles add a combining mark under each character: single underline (u̲n̲d̲e̲r̲), double underline (u̳n̳d̳e̳r̳) and dotted underline. They work on plain letters or on styled letters from the style mixer.

Why does the underline look broken between letters?

Each letter carries its own line, so the font decides how closely they join. Most phones show a near-continuous line; some fonts leave small gaps.

Will this text work on Instagram, TikTok and Discord?

Usually, in bios, captions, posts, comments and display names, because the result is ordinary Unicode text rather than a font. Usernames and handles normally allow only basic letters, numbers, periods and underscores, so styled letters are rejected there. Paste once and check the preview in the app before saving.
